newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SCALA SAYS HE IS STAYING AT STRUGGLING PERUGIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCALA SAYS HE IS STAYING AT STRUGGLING PERUGIA.

text.p: Perugia coach Nevio Scala, who was reportedly considering his position at the serie A club, said on Wednesday he was staying.
"There has been absolutely no episode that might have convinced me to hand in or not to hand in my resignation, about which I have never spoken," he said.

Italian newspapers had speculated that the former Parma coach, who took over in January when Giovanni Galeone was sacked, might be about to leave the newly-promoted club after failing to lift their form.
"Scala, the resignation in his pocket," said the daily Gazzetta Dello Sport in a headline.
Perugia are 16th in the league and in danger of relegation. When Scala took over in January they were mid-table.
"I'm staying in my job as I have done for three months, trying at this point, to speak as little as possible and working towards an aim that we all know perfectly well," he said.
